title: Classic Croatian Burek with Hummus Dipping Sauce
description: A traditional Croatian pastry filled with spiced meat, served with a creamy hummus dipping sauce for a delicious snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Croatian spiced ground beef
ingredients.notes: Ground beef mixed with 1 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp black pepper, and 0.5 tsp paprika

ingredients.name: Burek filling (Croatian-style)
ingredients.notes: Ground beef or lamb mixed with 1 onion, 1 clove garlic, and 1 tsp salt

instructions: Roll out puff pastry and cut into squares.
Place a spoonful of burek filling in the center of each square.
Fold the pastry in half to form a triangle and press edges to seal.
Brush tops with egg wash and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare hummus dipping sauce by mixing hummus with 1 tsp lemon juice and 0.5 tsp garlic powder.
Serve warm burek with hummus dipping sauce.
